summary: Two new members share the single seat their committee chair set out for them.
realLife: Pat Schroeder and Ron Dellums sat together on one chair at Armed Services after the chairman provided one place for both of them.
inGame: needs: a committee seating assignment and a record of members challenging it.

turns.what: A returning member brings another chair before the hearing opens.
turns.pulledBy: The member sees both new colleagues waiting for one place.
turns.writesBack: Both newcomers take seats at the table.

turns.what: One member takes the chair and asks the clerk to record that the other is present.
turns.pulledBy: The roll starts before another seat arrives.
turns.writesBack: The roll lists both members despite the seating.
